subject: Re: Status: repro clean, alignment on our stacks is harder
body:
Carmen, all — decision from Monday's review: the July demo runs on a curated set of 40 stacks that pass automatic alignment cleanly. The 40-step schedule with coarse pre-align becomes the default, and full no-touch automation moves to next quarter. Nobody outside the team sees the four bad-minimum examples until we can show the fix.

For the Aug launch review I need: the demo reel, the PSNR table against the open-source checkpoint, and a cost slide — the doubled per-stack alignment cost matters for the productization story.

Oyin and Wanjiru, the demo pipeline is yours through July as staffed. Bilal — freeze the eval harness by Jul 24 so the numbers in the deck are final.

Good trajectory, everyone.

Dmitri
